The '''Molavar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Molavar/Legends|Molavar]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Molavaran]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
